Based in PCMC (Pune) and surrounding areas, SAAHAS FOR PUNE is a dedicated NGO working tirelessly to rescue, treat, and care for stray animals. Since 2019, we’ve been on the streets helping voiceless souls find safety, health, and love.

💛 What We Do:
	•	Rescue and treatment of injured stray animals
	•	Sterilization and vaccination drives
	•	Adoption support and awareness
	•	On-ground stories, animal recoveries, and behind-the-scenes shelter life

Your overwhelming love, support, and visits make all the difference. Every donation – no matter how small – brings us closer to saving another life.


🎥 Subscribe to witness heart-touching rescues, healing journeys, and the unspoken bond between humans and animals.

📍 Want to visit us or support our cause? You’re always welcome!
